podcast.body: This song was performed by Joy Division on *Top of the Pops* months after the release of *Unknown Pleasures*. The performance was described as a grand and historic moment in music history, significantly boosting the band's popularity and leading to a powerful tour. Ian Curtis delivered a grandiose performance during this television appearance. "esa grandísima actuación histórica de Joy Division en Top of the Pops, en el que andan Transmission, yo creo que es uno de los momentos más históricos en la historia de la música cuando Joy Division sale actual a cantar Transmission en la televisión."

This song was recorded at the BBC on January 31st, 1979, and was used to open the show, noted for its record artwork that featured the radio telescope signature of a dying star, linking it to a cosmology analogy. "Jordy Vision and a version of Transmission recorded at the BBC on January 31st, 1979."
